# Run diagnostics for models {.tabset}

## Table of outputs for report

The following are the outputs from sequential updates to the 2023 model (update catch, cpue, length-frequency).

The tables are needed for the report. Modify the input R script to make sure it contains all the model names that you want to include.

```{r tables_of_results_2026}

source("00_extract_derived_quants.R")

knitr::kable(results_updates)
knitr::kable(results_sens)
knitr::kable(results_lik)
knitr::kable(results_sens_lik)
knitr::kable(results_grid)
knitr::kable(results_grid_lik)

results_updates
results_sens
results_grid
# results1_grid
# results2_grid


```

## Plot model outputs

First, pick a model, then run the scripts below to generate plots for:

* 1: CPUE
* 2: Length frequency
* 3: Selectivity
* 4: Tagging data
* 5: Recruitment
* 6: Movement
* 7: Fishing mortality (F)
* 8: Biomass estimates
* 9: Growth
* 10: Natural mortality (M)
* 11: ss3diags

```{r model_choice}

plot_model <- SS_output(dir= paste0(PATH_MODELRUNS,'/4_update_L50'),covar=TRUE,forecast=FALSE)
# plot_model <- SS_output(dir= paste0(PATH_SENSITIVITES,'/s1e_all_cpue'),covar=TRUE,forecast=FALSE)

base_dir <- paste0(PATH_MODELRUNS, '/4_update_L50',sep="")

MODEL_NAME <- '4_update_L50'
BASE_2026 <- '4_update_L50'
BASE_2023 <-  '0_base_2023'
mod_base <- '4_update_L50'


## paths

paths_for_models <- c(
  rep(PATH_MODELRUNS, length(mod_update_names))
)


models <- c(mod_update_names) #, mod_sens_names) #, mod_grid_names)

growth_models <- c(paste0(PATH_MODELRUNS,"4_update_L50",sep=""),

)

)


mod_catch_names <- c("4_update_L50","s2_update_som")

M_models <- c(paste0(PATH_MODELRUNS,"4_update_L50",sep=""),
```
